2026 Etsy Seller Fees Explained: Exact Math, Shipping Traps & Offsite Ads

Complete 2026 breakdown of every Etsy US seller fee ($0.20 listing, 6.5% transaction on item + shipping, 3% + $0.25 payments, and 12%/15% Offsite Ads) with real order examples.

1. The 4 Core Etsy US Fees Every Seller Pays in 2026

New Etsy sellers often assume Etsy only takes 6.5%. In reality, an organic US order incurs three stacked fees—and a fourth steep fee whenever an order is attributed to Etsy Offsite Ads.

Listing Fee: $0.20 USD per published item (auto-renews for $0.20 each time a multi-quantity listing sells). Transaction Fee: 6.5% applied to BOTH the item price AND buyer-paid shipping/gift wrap. Etsy Payments Processing (US): 3.0% + $0.25 of the total order amount (including sales tax collected by Etsy).

2. Real Example: A $34 Handmade Item + $5 Shipping ($39 Gross)

On a $39.00 organic US order, Etsy deducts $0.20 (listing) + $2.54 (6.5% transaction) + $1.42 (3% + $0.25 payment processing) = $4.16 (10.7% of top-line revenue) before you pay a dime for product materials or postage.

If that same buyer clicked an Etsy Google Shopping ad within the past 30 days, Etsy adds a 15% Offsite Ads fee ($5.85)—or 12% ($4.68) for shops above $10,000/year—pushing Etsy’s total take to $8.84–$10.01 (22.7%–25.7% of gross revenue!).

3. How Top 6-Figure Sellers Protect Their Margins

First, build a 3% blended price buffer across your catalog using our Etsy Offsite Ads Survival Calculator so attributed orders never lose money. Second, never rely on Etsy alone for repeat buyers: include a branded thank-you card with a QR code offering 10% off their next purchase on your own 0%-commission Shopify store.
